description.id: Platform Web-GIS yang menyatukan cuaca real-time, angka bebas jentik dari kader, dan laporan warga menjadi peta risiko DBD dan Malaria per kecamatan. Ada skor risiko 0–100, prediksi 14 hari, notifikasi otomatis, dan gamifikasi untuk warga.
description.en: A Web-GIS platform that merges real-time weather, larvae-free rates from health volunteers and citizen reports into a dengue and malaria risk map per district. It adds a 0–100 risk score, a 14-day forecast, automatic alerts and citizen gamification.

description.id: Asisten transaksi tunai untuk tunanetra. Kamera membaca banyak lembar Rupiah sekaligus, menghitung kembalian, dan berjalan 100% offline di Android. Saya menangani backend: konversi YOLOv8-Nano ke ONNX INT8 (±6 MB), state machine transaksi, kalkulator kembalian, filter IoU, dan basis data lokal.
description.en: A cash-transaction assistant for blind users. The camera reads several Rupiah notes at once, calculates change and runs 100% offline on Android. I handled the backend: converting YOLOv8-Nano to ONNX INT8 (~6 MB), the transaction state machine, change calculator, IoU filter and the local database.

description.id: Sistem reservasi meja restoran multi-cabang. Satu RESTful API Laravel + MongoDB melayani aplikasi Flutter untuk pelanggan dan dasbor Blade untuk admin. 10 endpoint diuji dengan PHPUnit dan Postman, respons rata-rata 214–589 ms, dan konflik slot waktu ditolak dengan 422.
description.en: A multi-branch restaurant table reservation system. One Laravel + MongoDB RESTful API serves a Flutter app for customers and a Blade dashboard for admins. 10 endpoints tested with PHPUnit and Postman, 214–589 ms average response, and overlapping slots rejected with a 422.

coverAlt.en: Illustration of the ReservaSeat table map

description.id: Platform rekomendasi jurusan dan simulasi akademik untuk siswa SMA kelas akhir. Mesin skoring deterministik (korelasi Pearson, sigmoid passing score, aturan SNBP/SNBT 2026) dipadukan dengan Gemini 2.5 Flash. Proposal untuk Hackathon JOINTS UGM 2026.
description.en: A major-recommendation and academic-simulation platform for final-year high-school students. A deterministic scoring engine (Pearson correlation, sigmoid passing score, SNBP/SNBT 2026 rules) is combined with Gemini 2.5 Flash. Proposed for the JOINTS UGM 2026 Hackathon.

description.id: Sistem scan absensi untuk gym klien, menggantikan pencatatan manual di buku yang menyulitkan pemantauan dan manajemen membership. Saya mengerjakannya sebagai full-stack developer.
description.en: A scan-based attendance system for a client gym, replacing paper-book logging that made memberships hard to track and manage. I worked on it as the full-stack developer.
